one_liner: Pitchers attacked Mike Trout with heat in 2025: 45.5% of the pitches he saw were four-seam fastballs, by far the most fastball-heavy diet in this group.
three_things: That diet came in hot -- the median pitch he saw was 92.5 mph, the highest median velocity in this set.
He still did damage: 90th-percentile exit velocity 104.6 mph, .361 estimated wOBA on contact.
A comparatively small contact sample: 589 batted balls over 2,440 pitches seen.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (>=300 pitches-faced floor). The 589 batted balls is a small sample, so the contact numbers carry more noise than the higher-volume hitters here. Estimated wOBA on contact is a batted-ball model over those 589 balls, not all 2,440 pitches, and says nothing about walks or strikeouts. No swing/miss or launch-angle column in this pull. Not park- or opponent-adjusted; not a prediction. 'Most fastball-heavy/highest median' is scoped to these twelve hitters.
